name: Holiday Southern Creamed Sweet Corn (Insoluble Corn Hull Warning)
whyItWorks: Whole corn kernels have tough outer cellulose hulls that cannot be digested by human enzymes. In stricturing Crohn's, whole corn kernels frequently cause complete bowel obstructions.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Trigger warning item: absolute avoid for stricturing Crohn's disease and active flares. Substitute smooth mashed potatoes or sweet potatoes.
watchOuts: Insoluble corn hulls pass undigested and can block narrowed intestines
